title: H3ABioNet
description: H3ABioNet is a Pan African bioinformatics network that supports genomics data analysis capacity across Africa. The site provides training, tools, workflows, technical guidance and data standards resources.
practicalUse: Public health genomics programs can use this resource to identify training materials, workflows and technical guidance for building or strengthening bioinformatics capacity, especially in African settings.
formatDetails: Website with training resources, bioinformatics tools, workflows, technical guidelines and data standards materials.
legacyTags: Some content is broader bioinformatics and human genomics, not exclusively pathogen genomics.
